# The journals of parts of the sheets of eval/free-sheets.json, drawn with seed 1, with the marks
# of the frames (internal/journal, TestPartsCodeSheets). After each sheet's number, task and
# scenario: how many parts of its markup the journal finds with just their strokes.

## 01 grasshopper correct: 4 of 4 parts
How the sheet was written, step by step. A part is a group of strokes written close together in place and time. Parts are numbered in the order they were first written; a part's first step says where on the sheet it stands. Erased writing, numbered apart, is erased strokes that no part holds.
1. Wrote part 1 (top centre).
2. Wrote part 2 (middle left).
3. Wrote part 3 (middle left).
4. Wrote part 4 (bottom left).
